n_an.long_name: Objectively analyzed mean fields for moles_of_nitrate_per_unit_mass_in_sea_water at standard depth levels.

n_mn.long_name: Average of all unflagged interpolated values at each standard depth level for moles_of_nitrate_per_unit_mass_in_sea_water in each grid-square which contain at least one measurement.

n_dd.long_name: The number of observations of moles_of_nitrate_per_unit_mass_in_sea_water in each grid-square at each standard depth level.

n_sd.long_name: The standard deviation about the statistical mean of moles_of_nitrate_per_unit_mass_in_sea_water in each grid-square at each standard depth level.

n_se.long_name: The standard error about the statistical mean of moles_of_nitrate_per_unit_mass_in_sea_water in each grid-square at each standard depth level.

n_oa.long_name: statistical mean value minus the objectively analyzed mean value for moles_of_nitrate_per_unit_mass_in_sea_water.

n_gp.long_name: The number of grid-squares within the smallest radius of influence around each grid-square which contain a statistical mean for moles_of_nitrate_per_unit_mass_in_sea_water.

n_sea.long_name: The standard error about the objectively analyzed data of moles_of_nitrate_per_unit_mass_in_sea_water defined in Levitus et al. (2012) GRL.
